https://example.org/bench.text: Vulkan decode on Bench. The Qwen3.8-4B distill at Q4_K_M decodes at 3.07 tokens per second with every layer on the Vulkan device. The two Vega compute units and the two Zen+ cores draw on one DDR4-2133 controller, so a split placement adds synchronization without adding bandwidth. FIXTURE-PAGE-BENCH-END

https://docs.example.net/llama-server-to.text: llama-server exposes GET /tools and POST /tools. The first lists each wrapped MCP tool as a function definition; the second invokes one tool with the params object taken verbatim from the request body. FIXTURE-PAGE-TOOLS-END
